attempts.answer:
The software product **OneLogin** provided at **onelogin.com** is directly provided and operated by **One Identity LLC** (a business unit of Quest Software), originally developed and operated by **OneLogin, Inc.** prior to its acquisition by One Identity.

### Evidence & Provider Statements
* **Website Legal Notices & Copyright (`onelogin.com`):** The footer across `onelogin.com` designates the operating entity: 
  > *"© One Identity LLC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. Legal | Terms of Use | Privacy Policy"*
* **Terms of Use:** 
  > *"The following terms and conditions of use (these “Terms of Use”) are terms of a legal agreement between you and One Identity LLC (“One Identity”) and govern the terms and conditions of your use of and access to One Identity's websites and online information."*
* **Service Offerings & Trademarks:** One Identity LLC's legal documentation explicitly includes OneLogin offerings under products and services purchased from *"One Identity LLC. or a subsidiary of One Identity LLC"*, and lists OneLogin as a registered trademark owned by One Identity LLC.
* **Developer Agreement / Operating Predecessor:** Legacy developer terms on `developers.onelogin.com` identified the original developer/operating entity as **OneLogin, Inc.** (*"These Terms of Service shall apply to your use of the web-based single sign-on services provided by OneLogin, Inc."*).
